properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 15 at 6:50PM CST until November 15 at 8:15PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
properties.description:
SMWHGX

The National Weather Service in League City has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX from 20 to 60
NM...
Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 815 PM CST.

* At 648 PM CST, a line of severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts was located 40 NM off the Upper Texas Coast, moving
southeast at 30 kn
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.
